title: Teferi Phases Out Zhalfir and Shiv
summary: Teferi preserves two lands from Phyrexia, but leaves their inhabitants separated from Dominaria.
narrative: During the Phyrexian invasion, Teferi phased Zhalfir and Shiv out of normal reality in an effort to save their populations.
His later restoration of Shiv could not undo the isolation of Zhalfir, a loss that shaped his actions for centuries.
